> 第9章 滚下来（第1页）
张云脚下缭绕着一层浅浅的淡青灵气，在洞府内来回移动，脚下每一步都给人一种玄妙感。
这般迈动了好半刻钟后，张云嘴角微笑停了下来。
三日时间，他没闲着，将从万界功法阁得来的上等功法粗略练了练。
作为一门身法为主的功法，学会了别的不说，躲避攻击和逃跑速度方面，绝对是大幅提升！
正想着，耳边忽然传来一道响彻整座第九峰上下的声音。
刚走出来，就见一位长发飘飘的青衣男子，正脚踏飞剑，一脸傲然飞临在第九峰上空。
此人张云认得，宗主的二徒弟，慕盛！
看着对方飞临峰头的姿态，张云面色一沉：“下来！”
慕盛看到张云出现正准备开口，听到这话嘴角不由勾起一丝轻蔑，高傲昂头：“九长老，我是奉师尊之命前来……”
慕盛并未在意，仍旧弯着嘴角开口：“九长老……”
张云再次冷喝，这回直接翻手就是一道飞剑从储物戒指中飞出，破空直指对方射去。
慕盛神色一凝，立马取出一柄长剑‘铿’地挡下飞剑，冷声道：“九长老，你竟敢对我出手！？”
张云一声暴喝，右手用力向下一压。
那给慕盛用长剑挡下的飞剑之上，‘轰’的猛然爆发出一股惊人灵气。
慕盛脸色一变，来不及躲闪直接给这股灵气震中，连人带剑从空中摔落而下，狼狈落在了峰头前的一棵树杈上。
只闻一道破风声传至耳边，下一秒肩膀上已多了一只手掌。
整个身子直接给这只手掌强行拽向地面，以一个狗吃屎的姿势狠狠趴摔了地上。
“没人教过你。若非十万火急，长老峰内不允许大声喧哗，更不允许弟子飞临于峰头吗？”

张云站在一旁轻拂袖袍，冷冷开口。
慕盛此刻摔得灰头土脸，听到这训斥大恼，怒吼：“张云，你找死！！”
一身灵气爆发，起身就是一拳怒砸向张云。
张云直接一抬手，正正接住了这一拳。
慕盛拳头上灵气爆发，想要将直接将张云震飞出去。
但震得了半天却发现他爆发的拳劲灵气，仿佛正打在一面铜墙铁壁上，根本无法撼动丝毫。
他可是筑基期巅峰。这一拳的拳劲灵气爆发他可没留力。修为境界已经掉落到筑基期三重的张云应该直接被轰飞出去才对，怎么眼下……
还没来及多想，只感觉拳头就像是被一道钳子夹住，瞬间就被捏的变形，发出‘咔咔’骨折脆裂声。

> Chapter 9 Get Down (Page 1)
A shallow layer of light green spiritual energy lingered under Zhang Yun's feet, moving back and forth in the cave, giving people a sense of mystery with every step he took.
After moving like this for a quarter of an hour, Zhang Yun stopped smiling.
For three days, he was not idle and roughly practiced the superior skills he had obtained from the Wanjie Kung Fu Pavilion.
As a skill that focuses on body skills, if you learn it, among other things, your speed in dodging attacks and escaping will definitely be greatly improved!
Just as he was thinking about it, a sound that echoed throughout the entire Ninth Peak suddenly came to his ears.
As soon as he walked out, he saw a man in green with long flowing hair flying over the ninth peak with a flying sword.
Zhang Yun recognized this person, the sect master's second disciple, Mu Sheng!
Seeing the opponent flying towards the top of the mountain, Zhang Yun's face darkened: "Come down!"
Mu Sheng was about to speak when he saw Zhang Yun appear. Hearing these words, the corners of his mouth couldn't help but evoke a hint of contempt, and he raised his head arrogantly: "Elder Ninth, I came here on the order of Master..."
Mu Sheng didn't pay attention, and still curled his lips and said: "Ninth Elder..."
Zhang Yun shouted coldly again, this time he flipped his hand and a flying sword flew out from the storage ring, pierced the air and shot directly at the opponent.
Mu Sheng's expression condensed, and he immediately took out a long sword to block the flying sword, and said coldly: "Ninth Elder, how dare you attack me!?"
Zhang Yun shouted loudly and pressed down hard with his right hand.
The flying sword that Mu Sheng blocked with his long sword suddenly erupted with an astonishing spiritual energy.
Mu Sheng's expression changed. He had no time to dodge and was hit by the spiritual energy. He fell from the air with his sword and landed awkwardly on a tree branch in front of the peak.
He only heard the sound of breaking wind reaching his ears, and the next second there was an extra hand on his shoulder.
His whole body was forcefully pulled to the ground by this palm, and he fell to the ground like a dog eating shit.
"No one taught you. Unless there is an emergency, loud noises are not allowed in the Elder Peak, let alone disciples flying to the top of the peak?"
Zhang Yun stood aside and flicked his sleeves, speaking coldly.
Mu Sheng was in disgrace at this moment. Hearing this scolding, he was very angry and roared: "Zhang Yun, you are looking for death!!"
With a burst of spiritual energy, he stood up and punched Zhang Yun angrily.
Zhang Yun raised his hand and caught the punch.
Mu Sheng's spiritual energy exploded from his fist, trying to knock Zhang Yun away.
But after being shocked for a long time, he discovered that the aura of his fist force was hitting a copper wall and could not shake it at all.
He is at the peak of the foundation building stage. He didn't hold back the energy of this punch. Zhang Yun, whose cultivation level has dropped to the third level of the Foundation Establishment Stage, should be blown away directly. Why now...
Before I had time to think about it, I just felt that my fist was clamped by a pair of pliers, and it was instantly deformed, making a cracking sound.
